pattern: もう少しで（もうすこしで）
purpose: Describe coming close to an event or threshold.
keywords: もう少しで + Vところだった / potential / threshold
We are almost at the summit.
I was so close to a perfect score, but got one question wrong.
formation: もう少しで + Vところだった / potential / threshold
restrictions: With ところだった it often describes an event narrowly avoided.
mistake: The near event need not actually have happened.
